title: Digital Wallet & Payments Hub Analytics
thesis: Snowflake processes digital wallet transactions from Kinesis, detects fraud patterns with ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION, classifies risk levels, and sends SNS alerts — real-time payments intelligence without external ML infrastructure

talking_points: ₱42 billion in total payment volume this month — 18M transactions across 4 channels.
Fraud rate at 0.047% — below 0.05% threshold but trending up.
QR payments growing 28% MoM — now 35% of total transaction mix.
show: Highlight fraud rate trending toward threshold
tabs.call_out: ₱42B monthly TPV — fraud rate approaching 0.05% threshold

transition.line: Let's investigate the fraud patterns before they breach our limits.

talking_points: ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flagged QR channel — fraud rate spiked 3x in last 48 hours.
Pattern: multiple new accounts doing high-value QR purchases at same merchant cluster.
ML.CLASSIFICATION identifies 342 accounts with >0.85 fraud probability this week.
show: Show fraud rate timeseries with anomaly markers on QR channel
Display suspicious merchant cluster on map
tabs.call_out: QR fraud spike — coordinated attack on merchant cluster detected

transition.line: Early detection prevents losses. Let's look at the ecosystem health.

talking_points: Daily active transacting users: 1.2M — up 15% from last month.
Bills payment success rate: 99.7%. P2P: 99.9%. QR: 98.2% (lower due to merchant timeout issues).
125,000 merchants onboarded — sari-sari stores now 42% of merchant base.
tabs.call_out: 1.2M daily active users — sari-sari stores driving financial inclusion

transition.line: Let the CRO ask the system directly.

talking_points: Jennifer asks: 'What's the loss amount from confirmed fraud this month?'
Cortex Analyst: ₱19.7M in confirmed losses — 73% from account takeover attacks.
Follow-up: 'Show me similar fraud patterns from past cases' — searches 8,500 case narratives.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + fraud case search

talking_points: Kinesis → Snowpipe Streaming → ML scoring → SNS alerts — under 60 seconds end-to-end.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION + ML.CLASSIFICATION replace SageMaker for fraud detection.
Philippine digital payments: ₱8.7T in 2023. This monitors ₱42B monthly.
tabs.call_out: 60-second detect-to-alert — fraud stopped before it spreads

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine digital payments.
